resolution.note: acceptance entries (--verify) run on close --as done; failure exits 66

title: Flip task acceptance only through an executed verify command
body:
Outcome: tasks/*.json carry acceptance entries with a verify command and a passes flag; only `krn task close` sets passes after running the command, and close refuses a task whose verify fails.
Why: research 2026-11-09 (Anthropic, Effective harnesses for long-running agents, https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-harnesses-for-long-running-agents): a JSON feature list whose pass flag flips only after real verification stops agents declaring work done early; KRN closes tasks on a note.
Proof: a test closes a task whose verify exits nonzero and expects refusal; a passing verify records the flag.
Scope: src/task, test/task.
